insights.summary: The agent successfully implemented the requested micro-optimizations in the FlashInfer backend. It demonstrated strong code comprehension by correctly handling the edge cases of tensor initialization. While environmental constraints prevented full performance verification, the agent used alternative methods to ensure code quality.

Correct handling of indptr zero-index requirements
Efficient use of grep to find optimization targets
weaknesses: Relied heavily on the provided examples rather than deep independent profiling
